component.name: Tailscreen
component.summary: Share and view screens peer-to-peer over Tailscale

description.p: Tailscreen is a low-latency, encrypted peer-to-peer screen sharing tool that runs over Tailscale. This is the native Linux desktop app: it discovers screens on your tailnet, decodes H.264 or HEVC video with FFmpeg, and renders it through an OpenGL YUV-to-RGB pipeline inside native GTK4 chrome.
It also shares your own screen. X11 capture is encoded with libavcodec and served directly to viewers you approve; sharing on Wayland (via the ScreenCast portal) is not supported yet.
No manual device registration is required: the app brings up a tsnet node and connects directly, peer to peer.
Source build. Released builds carry their tag's version.
